notSignificant.general: No clear change in this record

unreliableRising.expert: Trend not reliable as a climate signal: documented data issue (rising, statistically significant)

unreliableFalling.expert: Trend not reliable as a climate signal: documented data issue (falling, statistically significant)

unreliableRisingRawOnly.expert: Trend not reliable as a climate signal: documented data issue (rising, significant before FDR only)

unreliableFallingRawOnly.expert: Trend not reliable as a climate signal: documented data issue (falling, significant before FDR only)

insufficient.general: Too little data for a trend

notComputed.general: The test could not be run.

notSignificant.general: No clear change shows in this record. That is not the same as no change.

fdr.general: This change holds up in the statistical tests.
fdr.expert: significant after autocorrelation and FDR correction

rawOnly.general: This change passes the basic test but not the stricter one, so treat it as uncertain.
rawOnly.expert: significant after autocorrelation correction, not after FDR correction

unreliableFdr.general: This number is not reliable: the data itself has a documented problem.
unreliableFdr.expert: statistically significant, but not reliable as a climate signal: see caution

unreliableRawOnly.general: This number is not reliable: the data itself has a documented problem.
unreliableRawOnly.expert: significant before FDR correction only, and not reliable as a climate signal: see caution

notAnalyzed.general: Too little data to work out a trend

notSignificantNote.general: No clear change is not the same as no change: the record may be too short or too noisy to tell.
notSignificantNote.expert: Not significant does not mean no change; the record may be too short or too variable to tell.

reliable.ok: No documented data problem affects this trend.
reliable.bad: Not reliable: the data itself has a documented problem (see the caution below).
